title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：thunder　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thunder 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the ranger ① heard the thunder that no villager in the valley would have counted, and he said the hearing was the whole of the season. The ② thunder, meaning the sound itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; thunder, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of thunder in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ thunder at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Thunder, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the ranger said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the thunder was the whole of the matter, meaning the fear and not the sound. The ⑥ thunder, meaning the fear and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; thunder, he said, is either something you hear or the only word that means both sound and a fear. He said the fear is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ thunder had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ thunder of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of counting; thunder, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ thunder I remember is the thunder counted in the survey, which closed in 1983 and is still counted as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Thunder, my mother said in 1985, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all thunder, she said, is a fear that has agreed to look like sound. She said the fear was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 雷；雷声（指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 雷；雷声（指那阵雷本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：hear the thunder 听见这一阵雷
D. n. 雷；雷声（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 雷之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的雷之事）
F. n. 雷；雷声（指踏勘记录里写到、被清点的那一阵）
G. n. 雷、惊惧（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 惊惧（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: heard the thunder that no villager in the valley would have counted
The thunder, meaning the sound itself and not the staff
Every sort of thunder in that valley
the thunder at the far ridge
the thunder was the whole of the matter
the thunder had become a line in a survey
The thunder of the whole thing

answers.why: hear the thunder 意为“听见这一阵雷”，1976 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯清点的一阵雷做了一遍。
thunder 意为“雷；雷声”，指那阵雷本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被清点。
thunder 意为“雷；雷声”，指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
thunder 意为“雷；雷声”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
thunder 意为“雷、惊惧”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这阵惊惧就是那件事的全部。
thunder 意为“惊惧”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那阵雷，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
thunder 意为“雷；雷声”，指踏勘记录里写到、被清点的那一阵，到 1981 年这一阵成了踏勘记录里的一行。
thunder 意为“雷之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的雷之事是一处山谷和三个季节的清点。
thunder 意为“雷；雷声”，我记得的是踏勘记录里清点过的那一阵，1983 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一阵。
thunder 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，雷是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的雷。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年那位守林人听见了山谷里没有一位村民肯清点的一阵雷，他说这一遍才是那个季节的全部。（hear the thunder）
那阵雷，指的是那阵雷本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被清点。（thunder）
那处山谷里每一类雷旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（thunder）
最远那道山脊那阵雷，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（thunder）
叔叔说这阵惊惧就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那阵雷。（thunder）
1985 年母亲说，雷是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的雷。（thunder）
